originalTitle: Bill Miller's investing strategy: How the legendary fund manager outperformed the market for 15 straight years
simplifiedContent: Bill Miller is a well-known investor who was able to do better than the overall stock market for 15 years in a row. He achieved this by using a strategy that involves looking for stocks that are undervalued, being patient, and not following the crowd. Miller focuses on finding companies with strong finances and a "margin of safety", which means they are unlikely to lose a lot of value. He holds onto these stocks until they reach a fair price or until his reasons for investing in them change. This approach helped Miller outperform the market, making him a successful and legendary fund manager.

originalTitle: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank posts Rs 34 crore Q1 loss; asset quality stress persists
simplifiedContent: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank lost Rs 34 crore in the first quarter of the year, which is the fifth quarter in a row that it has lost money. This is mostly because some of the loans it gave to people or businesses are not being paid back, which is known as "asset quality stress". The bank's bad loans, or "non-performing assets", make up 6.1% of its total loans, which is a high percentage. Although the bank's loss is smaller than it was before, it's still losing money, which is a concern. This news matters because it shows that the bank is still struggling with bad loans, which can affect its overall health and performance.

originalTitle: Muthoot Finance reports 25% rise in Q1 profit, announces leadership transition
simplifiedContent: Muthoot Finance, a company that lends money to people who use their gold as security, made a profit of Rs 2,550 crore in the first quarter of the year. This is 25% more than they made in the same period last year. The main reason for this increase is that their gold loan business is doing very well. The company is also making some changes at the top, with Alexander George Muthoot set to become the new managing director on October 1, if the shareholders agree. This news matters because it shows that the company is performing well and is planning for the future with new leadership.

originalTitle: Week Ahead: Wall Street eyes US jobs data, SpaceX debut earnings and Disney results
simplifiedContent: This week, investors are waiting to see how many new jobs were created in the US in July. This information is important because it can affect the decisions made by the people in charge of setting interest rates in the US. Interest rates can influence how much it costs to borrow money, which can impact the stock market. Investors will also be paying attention to the financial results of two big companies: SpaceX, which is reporting its earnings for the first time, and Disney. The jobs report is the most important thing to watch this week because it can give clues about what might happen with interest rates in the coming months.

originalTitle: Sebi order against Zee likely to delay planned  ₹3,143-crore fundraise
simplifiedContent: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has made a decision that will affect Zee's plans to raise money. Zee was planning to raise ₹3,143 crore, but Sebi's order will likely delay this. Sebi has stopped Zee from buying, selling, or dealing with securities for a certain period of time. This means Zee cannot move forward with its plan to raise money right now. Sebi's order is a significant development that will impact Zee's ability to raise funds.

originalTitle: Yen Traders Brace for More Intervention With US at Japan’s Side
simplifiedContent: Some big investors who deal with the Japanese yen are waiting to see what happens next. Last week, Japan and the US worked together to try to strengthen the yen, and it caused a big jump in the currency's value. This happened when they took action in both Japan and the US at the same time. Now, these investors are watching closely to see if Japan and the US will do something like this again when markets open in Asia. This matters because it could affect the value of the yen again, which is important for people who invest in or trade with Japan.
